cc_hero_of_triumphant_song.name: Hero of Triumphant Song
cc_hero_of_triumphant_song.effect_4pc: While the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases the wearer's SPD by 6%. When the wearer's memosprite attacks, increases the wearer's and memosprite's CRIT DMG by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

cc_poet_of_mourning_collapse.name: Poet of Mourning Collapse
cc_poet_of_mourning_collapse.effect_4pc: Decreases the wearer's SPD by 8%. Before entering battle, if the wearer's SPD is lower than 110/95, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 20%/32%. This effect applies to the wearer's memosprite at the same time.

cc_iron_cavalry_against_the_scourge.name: Iron Cavalry Against the Scourge
cc_iron_cavalry_against_the_scourge.effect_4pc: If the wearer's Break Effect is 150% or higher, the Break DMG dealt to the enemy target ignores 10% of their DEF. If the wearer's Break Effect is 250% or higher, the Super Break DMG dealt to the enemy target additionally ignores 15% of their DEF.

cc_the_wind_soaring_valorous.name: The Wind-Soaring Valorous
cc_the_wind_soaring_valorous.effect_4pc: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 6%. When the wearer uses a follow-up attack, increases the DMG dealt by Ultimate by 36%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

cc_firesmith_of_lava_forging.name: Firesmith of Lava-Forging
cc_firesmith_of_lava_forging.effect_4pc: Increases the wearer's Skill DMG by 12%. After unleashing Ultimate, increases the wearer's Fire DMG by 12% for the next attack.

cc_wastelander_of_banditry_desert.name: Wastelander of Banditry Desert
cc_wastelander_of_banditry_desert.effect_4pc: When attacking debuffed enemies, the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and their CRIT DMG increases by 20% against Imprisoned enemies.

cc_the_ashblazing_grand_duke.name: The Ashblazing Grand Duke
cc_the_ashblazing_grand_duke.effect: Increases the DMG dealt by follow-up attacks by 20%.
cc_the_ashblazing_grand_duke.effect_4pc: When the wearer uses follow-up attacks, increases the wearer's ATK by 6% for every time the follow-up attack deals DMG. This effect can stack up to 8 time(s) and lasts for 3 turn(s). This effect is removed the next time the wearer uses a follow-up attack.

cc_prisoner_in_deep_confinement.name: Prisoner in Deep Confinement
cc_prisoner_in_deep_confinement.effect_4pc: For every DoT the target enemy is afflicted with, the wearer will ignore 6% of its DEF when dealing DMG to it. This effect is valid for a max of 3 DoTs.

cc_pioneer_diver_of_dead_waters.name: Pioneer Diver of Dead Waters
cc_pioneer_diver_of_dead_waters.effect: Increases DMG dealt to enemies with debuffs by 12%.
cc_pioneer_diver_of_dead_waters.effect_4pc: Increases CRIT Rate by 4%. The wearer deals 8%/12% increased CRIT DMG to enemies with at least 2/3 debuffs. After the wearer inflicts a debuff on enemy targets, the aforementioned effects increase by 100%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

cc_watchmaker_master_of_dream_machinatio.name: Watchmaker, Master of Dream Machinations
cc_watchmaker_master_of_dream_machinatio.effect_4pc: When the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally, all allies' Break Effect increases by 30% for 2 turn(s). This effect cannot be stacked.

cc_passerby_of_wandering_cloud.name: Passerby of Wandering Cloud
cc_passerby_of_wandering_cloud.effect_4pc: At the start of the battle, immediately regenerates 1 Skill Point.

cc_musketeer_of_wild_wheat.name: Musketeer of Wild Wheat
cc_musketeer_of_wild_wheat.effect_4pc: The wearer's SPD increases by 6% and Basic ATK DMG increases by 10%.

cc_longevous_disciple.name: Longevous Disciple
cc_longevous_disciple.effect_4pc: When the wearer is hit or has their HP consumed by an ally or themselves, their CRIT Rate increases by 8% for 2 turn(s) and up to 2 stacks.

cc_messenger_traversing_hackerspace.name: Messenger Traversing Hackerspace
cc_messenger_traversing_hackerspace.effect_4pc: When the wearer uses their Ultimate on an ally, SPD for all allies increases by 12% for 1 turn(s). This effect cannot be stacked.

cc_hunter_of_glacial_forest.name: Hunter of Glacial Forest
cc_hunter_of_glacial_forest.effect_4pc: After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their CRIT DMG increases by 25% for 2 turn(s).

cc_eagle_of_twilight_line.name: Eagle of Twilight Line
cc_eagle_of_twilight_line.effect_4pc: After the wearer uses their Ultimate, their action is Advanced Forward by 25%.

cc_world_remaking_deliverer.name: World-Remaking Deliverer
cc_world_remaking_deliverer.effect_4pc: After the wearer uses Basic ATK or Skill, if the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases Max HP of the wearer and their memosprite by 24%, and increases all allies' DMG by 15% until the wearer's next Basic ATK or Skill.

cc_self_enshrouded_recluse.name: Self-Enshrouded Recluse
cc_self_enshrouded_recluse.effect_4pc: Increases Shield Effect provided by the wearer by 12%. When an ally target has a Shield provided by the wearer, the ally target's CRIT DMG increases by 15%.

cc_knight_of_purity_palace.name: Knight of Purity Palace
cc_knight_of_purity_palace.effect_4pc: Increases the max DMG that can be absorbed by the Shield created by the wearer by 20%.

cc_band_of_sizzling_thunder.name: Band of Sizzling Thunder
cc_band_of_sizzling_thunder.effect_4pc: When the wearer uses their Skill, increases the wearer's ATK by 20% for 1 turn(s).

cc_as_navigator_isee_sees_it.name: As Navigator Isee Sees It
cc_as_navigator_isee_sees_it.effect_4pc: When the wearer enters combat or uses Skill, the DMG dealt by their Skill and Ultimate increases by 18%, stacking up to 3 times. At the start of the wearer's turn or after using Ultimate, removes 1 stack of this effect.

cc_divine_querying_master_smith.name: Divine-Querying Master Smith
cc_divine_querying_master_smith.effect_4pc: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt to enemy targets in the DEF reduction state by 28%. After the wearer inflicts the DEF reduction state on an enemy target, all allies gain "Comburent" for 2 turns. This effect cannot be stacked. DMG dealt by ally targets with "Comburent" increases by 15%. This effect can be triggered again after the wearer uses an attack.

cc_champion_of_streetwise_boxing.name: Champion of Streetwise Boxing
cc_champion_of_streetwise_boxing.effect_4pc: After the wearer attacks or is hit, their ATK increases by 5% for the rest of the battle. This effect can stack up to 5 time(s).

cc_thief_of_shooting_meteor.name: Thief of Shooting Meteor
cc_thief_of_shooting_meteor.effect_4pc: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by 16%. After the wearer inflicts Weakness Break on an enemy, regenerates 3 Energy.

cc_ever_glorious_magical_girl.name: Ever-Glorious Magical Girl
cc_ever_glorious_magical_girl.effect_4pc: The Elation DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprites ignores 10% of targets' DEF. For every 5 accumulated Punchline allies gain, the Elation DMG dealt additionally ignores 1% of targets' DEF, stacking up to 10 time(s).

cc_diviner_of_distant_reach.name: Diviner of Distant Reach
cc_diviner_of_distant_reach.effect_4pc: Before entering combat, if the wearer's SPD is greater than or equal to 120/160, increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 10%/18%. When the wearer uses Elation Skill for the first time in each battle, enhances all allies' Elation by 10%. This effect cannot stack.

cc_guard_of_wuthering_snow.name: Guard of Wuthering Snow
cc_guard_of_wuthering_snow.effect_4pc: At the beginning of the turn, if the wearer's HP is equal to or less than 50%, restores HP equal to 8% of their Max HP and regenerates 5 Energy.

cc_genius_of_brilliant_stars.name: Genius of Brilliant Stars
cc_genius_of_brilliant_stars.effect_4pc: When the wearer deals DMG to the target enemy, ignores 10% DEF. If the target enemy has Quantum Weakness, the wearer additionally ignores 10% DEF.

cc_warrior_goddess_of_sun_and_thunder.name: Warrior Goddess of Sun and Thunder
cc_warrior_goddess_of_sun_and_thunder.effect_4pc: When the wearer or their memosprite provides healing to ally targets other than themselves, the wearer gains "Gentle Rain," which lasts for 2 turn(s) and can only trigger once per turn. While the wearer has "Gentle Rain," SPD increases by 6% and all allies' CRIT DMG increases by 15%. This effect cannot stack.

cc_wavestrider_captain.name: Wavestrider Captain
cc_wavestrider_captain.effect_4pc: When the wearer becomes the target of another ally target's ability, gains 1 stack of "Help," stacking up to 2 time(s). If there are 2 stack(s) of "Help" when the wearer uses their Ultimate, consumes all "Help" to increase the wearer's ATK by 48% for 1 turn(s).

cc_scholar_lost_in_erudition.name: Scholar Lost in Erudition
cc_scholar_lost_in_erudition.effect_4pc: Increases DMG dealt by Skill and Ultimate by 20%. After using Ultimate, additionally increases the DMG dealt by the next Skill by 25%.

cc_sacerdos_relived_ordeal.name: Sacerdos' Relived Ordeal
cc_sacerdos_relived_ordeal.effect_4pc: When using Skill or Ultimate on one ally target, increases the ability target's CRIT DMG by 18%, lasting for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).

ew_past_evils_of_the_borehole_planet_dis.name: Past Evils of the Borehole Planet Disaster

ew_lost_echo_of_the_shared_wish.name: Lost Echo of the Shared Wish

ew_high_hopes_of_the_falsely_enlightened.name: High Hopes of the Falsely Enlightened

po_amphoreus_the_eternal_land.name: Amphoreus, The Eternal Land
po_amphoreus_the_eternal_land.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. While the wearer's memosprite is on the field, increases all allies' SPD by 8%. This effect cannot be stacked.

po_arcadia_of_woven_dreams.name: Arcadia of Woven Dreams
po_arcadia_of_woven_dreams.effect: When there are currently more or less than 4 ally targets in battle, each additional/missing ally target increases the wearer and their memosprite's DMG by 9%/12%, up to a maximum of 4/3 stacks.

po_belobog_of_the_architects.name: Belobog of the Architects
po_belobog_of_the_architects.effect: Increases the wearer's DEF by 15%. When the wearer's Effect Hit Rate is 50% or higher, the wearer gains an extra 15% DEF.

po_bone_collection_s_serene_demesne.name: Bone Collection's Serene Demesne
po_bone_collection_s_serene_demesne.effect: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 12%. When the wearer's Max HP is 5000 or higher, increases the wearer's and their memosprite's CRIT DMG by 28%.

po_broken_keel.name: Broken Keel
po_broken_keel.effect: Increases the wearer's Effect RES by 10%. When the wearer's Effect RES is at 30% or higher, all allies' CRIT DMG increases by 10%.

po_celestial_differentiator.name: Celestial Differentiator
po_celestial_differentiator.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 16%. When the wearer's current CRIT DMG reaches 120% or higher, after entering battle, the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by 60% until the end of their first attack.

po_city_of_converging_stars.name: City of Converging Stars
po_city_of_converging_stars.effect: When the wearer uses a Follow-Up ATK, increases their ATK by 24% for 2 turns. When an enemy target is defeated, increases CRIT DMG for all allies by 12% for the rest of the current battle. This effect cannot stack

po_cosmic_life_sciences_institute.name: Cosmic Life Sciences Institute
po_cosmic_life_sciences_institute.effect: When entering combat, if the wearer's Max Energy is greater than or equal to 200, for every 1 excess point, increases the wearer's DMG dealt by 0.2%, up to a max increase of 32%.

po_duran_dynasty_of_running_wolves.name: Duran, Dynasty of Running Wolves
po_duran_dynasty_of_running_wolves.effect: When an ally uses follow-up attacks, the wearer gains 1 stack of Merit, stacking up to 5 time(s). Each stack of Merit increases the DMG dealt by the wearer's follow-up attacks by 5%. When there are 5 stacks, additionally increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 25%.

po_fallen_star_anchorage.name: Fallen Star Anchorage
po_fallen_star_anchorage.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When entering combat, if the wearer and another teammate are both Trailblaze Companions characters, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 32%.

po_firmament_frontline_glamoth.name: Firmament Frontline: Glamoth
po_firmament_frontline_glamoth.effect: Increases the wearer's ATK by 12%. When the wearer's SPD is equal to or higher than 135/160, the wearer deals 12%/18% more DMG.

po_fleet_of_the_ageless.name: Fleet of the Ageless
po_fleet_of_the_ageless.effect: Increases the wearer's Max HP by 12%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, all allies' ATK increases by 8%.

po_forge_of_the_kalpagni_lantern.name: Forge of the Kalpagni Lantern
po_forge_of_the_kalpagni_lantern.effect: Increases the wearer's SPD by 6%. When the wearer hits an enemy target that has Fire Weakness, the wearer's Break Effect increases by 40%, lasting for 1 turn(s).

po_giant_tree_of_rapt_brooding.name: Giant Tree of Rapt Brooding
po_giant_tree_of_rapt_brooding.effect: Increases the wearer's SPD by 6%. When the wearer's Speed is 135/180 or higher, increases the wearer and their memosprite's Outgoing Healing by 12%/20%.

po_inert_salsotto.name: Inert Salsotto
po_inert_salsotto.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When the wearer's current CRIT Rate reaches 50% or higher, the wearer's Ultimate and follow-up attack DMG increases by 15%.

po_izumo_gensei_and_takama_divine_realm.name: Izumo Gensei and Takama Divine Realm
po_izumo_gensei_and_takama_divine_realm.effect: Increases the wearer's ATK by 12%. When entering battle, if at least one other ally follows the same Path as the wearer, then the wearer's CRIT Rate increases by 12%.

po_lushaka_the_sunken_seas.name: Lushaka, the Sunken Seas
po_lushaka_the_sunken_seas.effect: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. If the wearer is not the first character in the team lineup, then increases the ATK of the first character in the team lineup by 12%.

po_pan_cosmic_commercial_enterprise.name: Pan-Cosmic Commercial Enterprise
po_pan_cosmic_commercial_enterprise.effect: Increases the wearer's Effect Hit Rate by 10%. Meanwhile, the wearer's ATK increases by an amount that is equal to 25% of the current Effect Hit Rate, up to a maximum of 25%.

po_penacony_land_of_the_dreams.name: Penacony, Land of the Dreams
po_penacony_land_of_the_dreams.effect: Increases wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. Increases DMG by 10% for all other allies that are of the same Type as the wearer.

po_punklorde_stage_zero.name: Punklorde Stage Zero
po_punklorde_stage_zero.effect: Increases the wearer's Elation by 8%. When Elation reaches 40%/80% for the first time in battle, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 20%/32%.

po_revelry_by_the_sea.name: Revelry by the Sea
po_revelry_by_the_sea.effect: Increases the wearer's ATK by 12%. When the wearer's ATK is higher than or equal to 2,400/3,600, increases the DoT DMG dealt by 12%/24%.

po_rutilant_arena.name: Rutilant Arena
po_rutilant_arena.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When the wearer's current CRIT Rate reaches 70% or higher, the wearer's Basic ATK and Skill DMG increase by 20%.

po_sigonia_the_unclaimed_desolation.name: Sigonia, the Unclaimed Desolation
po_sigonia_the_unclaimed_desolation.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 4%. When an enemy target gets defeated, the wearer's CRIT DMG increases by 4%, stacking up to 10 time(s).

po_space_sealing_station.name: Space Sealing Station
po_space_sealing_station.effect: Increases the wearer's ATK by 12%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, the wearer's ATK increases by an extra 12%.

po_sprightly_vonwacq.name: Sprightly Vonwacq
po_sprightly_vonwacq.effect: Increases the wearer's Energy Regeneration Rate by 5%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 120 or higher, the wearer's action is Advanced Forward by 40% immediately upon entering battle.

po_talia_kingdom_of_banditry.name: Talia: Kingdom of Banditry
po_talia_kingdom_of_banditry.effect: Increases the wearer's Break Effect by 16%. When the wearer's SPD reaches 145 or higher, the wearer's Break Effect increases by an extra 20%.

po_tengoku_livestream.name: Tengoku Livestream
po_tengoku_livestream.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 16%, If 3 or more Skill Points are consumed in the same turn, additionally increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 32% for 3 turns.

po_the_wondrous_bananamusement_park.name: The Wondrous BananAmusement Park
po_the_wondrous_bananamusement_park.effect: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 16%. When a target summoned by the wearer is on the field, CRIT DMG additionally increases by 32%.
